updates.note: Management stated working capital cycle will trend towards long-term operating range of 45 to 50 days.
updates.quote: As these benefits gradually normalize, we expect the working capital cycle to trend towards our long-term operating range of 45 to 50 days.

updates.note: Management reiterated the FMEG EBITDA margin target of 8% to 10% by FY30.
updates.quote: So over the longer term, I believe we would end up in that kind of a range of 8% to 10% of the EBITDA margin.

updates.note: EHV plant commissioning timeline updated to FY 2028 (April/May next year).
updates.quote: we are expecting the EHV plant to now commission somewhere in FY 2028, the next year, though, so FY28.

updates.note: Reiterated objective to grow FMEG at 1.5x to 2x industry growth rate.
updates.quote: Our objective continues to be growing at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth rate while steadily enhancing profitability.

updates.note: Reiterated sustainable margins for EPC business in high single-digit range over medium to long term.
updates.quote: Over the medium- to long-term, we continue to expect sustainable margins for the EPC business to remain in the high single-digit range

updates.note: Reiterated medium- to long-term EBITDA margins for Wires and Cables within guided range of 11% to 13%.
updates.quote: we remain confident of sustaining medium- to long-term EBITDA margins within our guided range of 11% to 13%.

updates.note: Management reaffirmed the execution run rate for BharatNet and RDSS projects.
updates.quote: Bharat Net maybe INR800 crores to INR1,000 crores and maybe RDSS INR800 crores to INR1,000 crores execution this year.
